tools.name: get_open_slots
tools.description: Free 15-minute slots for a video call with Felix, live from his calendar. Times are returned in the given IANA time zone and as UTC ISO strings for book_call.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Books one 15-minute video call in an open slot. Only after the person confirmed the time and their e-mail. Google e-mails the invite with the Meet link to that address.
